title: Print a number in decimal
task: Write a program that prints the unsigned number stored at the label value in decimal, followed by a newline, with the write system call (a7 = 64), and then exits with code 0 (a7 = 93). The tests change the number at value.
starter:
# print-number -- practice exercise (MAVILERA)
# Print the unsigned word at value in decimal, then a newline; exit with 0.
# Hint: build the digits from the right into a buffer with remu/divu, then write them in one call.
        .data
value:  .word 1234
buf:    .space 12
        .text
main:   # your code
        li   a0, 0
        li   a7, 93
        ecall
